name: Deep Multi-Tier Commit Ancestry Resolution

description: Validates discovery of the lowest common ancestor (LCA) between C5 (5c8b2011) and C4 (d19a7e30) as C1.

description: Validates understanding that Git DAG arrows point backward to past parents with zero circular causality loops.

name: Merge Parent Allocation Integrity
description: Validates that Parent 1 is allocated to target branch C5 (main) and Parent 2 is allocated to incoming branch C4 (feature/auth-gateway).

name: Remote Graph Synchronization Reasoning

name: DAG Acyclic Guarantee Verification
description: Validates understanding of the acyclic property in Git DAGs preventing circular time loops.

name: Active HEAD Branch Identification
description: Validates that HEAD is attached to the main branch pointing to commit C7.
